solution: Fibre supports high data rates, so it can carry the combined traffic between campus buildings without the link becoming a bottleneck. Low attenuation over the required distance and resistance to electromagnetic interference are acceptable alternative properties when linked to a benefit in this context.

marking_points.criterion: States a relevant property: high available bandwidth/data rate, low attenuation over the required distance, or resistance to electromagnetic interference.

Explains how that property supports the campus link, such as accommodating aggregate traffic, maintaining the signal over the distance, or avoiding interference-related disruption. Do not award a separate point for repeating that fibre was selected.

acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent technically correct answers meeting the same scoped requirement; valid alternative algorithms accepted where they meet any explicit question constraints.
partial_credit_notes: Award each specified criterion independently up to the allocation. Credit correct method after an earlier slip when consistent; do not award the same point twice.

verification.technical: Independently solved; compared relevant source MS points, with obsolete/source-error assertions not imported.
verification.code_execution: No executable code required; explicit answer/trace checked manually.
